messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Dedicated pool 'maplebank-dedicated-1' node gpu-17 reported repeated power/thermal oscillation; automatic drain started. Affected tenants: maplebank-prod (VPC), small burst traffic impacted. Severity: P1. Runbook: dedpool-drain -> tenant-isolate.

Ash (oncall): ack. I'm on it. tagging @Samir and @Priya for node/eviction follow-up.

Samir (eng-ops): looking now — metrics show node gpu-17 power draw spike ~10:23 UTC then 3x reboots at kernel level. NVMe controller also showing I/O retries.

Priya (sre): can we confirm which tenants saw errors? quick smoke on logs for maplebank-prod?

Jordan (SE): I just got a support ping from Carmen at MapleBank — they saw a handful of 502s on a few endpoints around 10:24. They have dedicated capacity but there was short-lived increased latency for long generations. No data loss reported. Customer ok with mitigation but wants timeline.

Ash (oncall): action plan: 1) keep node drained/evicted, 2) isolate maplebank tenant to fallback reserved capacity, 3) kick off hardware replacement ticket with ops, 4) notify customer success. Priya/Samir you two own steps 1-2. Kasia please prep capacity warm-up if we need to shift workloads. Carmen pls inform MapleBank of temporary degraded latency and that we're moving them to a hot-standby pool.

Samir (eng-ops): starting controlled eviction: `rdctl pool evict --pool maplebank-dedicated-1 --node gpu-17 --grace 30s`

Samir (eng-ops): log tail snippet from node (10:22-10:25):
```
[10:23:12] nvme0: I/O 512 qid 0 timeout
[10:23:15] kernel: GPU: powerflt: device 0000:81:00.0 exceeded power budget
[10:23:16] watchdog: GPU reset requested
[10:23:18] systemd: machine rebooting
```

Priya (sre): eviction completed, pods gracefully drained. Tenant maplebank-prod failed over to fallback pool `maplebank-fallback-1` at 10:27 UTC. Latency spike subsided.

Kasia (platform): warming additional nodes in fallback pool — `scale-dedicated --pool maplebank-fallback-1 --replicas +2` in progress. ETA ~6 minutes. If traffic rises we have autoscale policy to add burst capacity.

Carmen (CS): told MapleBank support: "we detected a flaky GPU node and moved your workloads to a hot-standby pool; you may see transient latency, no requests dropped; our hardware team is replacing the node and we'll follow up with a timeline and postmortem." They asked for an ETA on full capacity return.

Ash (oncall): hardware ticket created: HT-10291 -> ops-hw. Assigned to @Kasia to coordinate with datacenter techs. Requesting priority swap/replace.

Samir (eng-ops): flagged firmware + ECC counters for the node; looks like a failing PSU/regulator causing oscillation. Ops to RMA. Putting a hold on any automatic re-provision until replacement.

Priya (sre): monitoring for any cross-tenant spillover: no other tenants showing elevated error rates after failover. We'll keep 15m heightened monitoring.

Jordan (SE): MapleBank asked about SLA credit window — I told them we'll provide incident timeline and follow-up once hardware replace complete. They're appreciative of the proactive failover.

Kasia (platform): ops scheduled on-site slot at 2025-08-31T15:30Z (local DC). ETA for node back in service ~3 hours including validation. I'll update HT-10291.

Ash (oncall): handoff: my shift ends in 45m. Priya will take lead for monitoring and incident updates until hardware confirms replacement. Samir continue bookkeeping of evictions and config changes. Carmen keep customer comms.

Priya (sre): taking lead. Next updates at +30m or on significant change. Raising a quick action item: need to run post-recovery regression tests for MapleBank prompt sets once node back to normal.

Samir (eng-ops): saved eviction traces and kernel logs to incident workspace: /incidents/3387654321/artifacts. Also added the `rdctl` commands used.

Kasia (platform): reminder — schedule a post-incident run for dedpool healthcheck and re-run model quantization smoke if node replaced.

Carmen (CS): MapleBank support updated, asked us to CC their infra lead once OOB window scheduled. I have their contact.

incident-bot: Reminder: page has been acknowledged and an incident channel will be created for the postmortem — link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3387654321.

Ash (oncall): closing loop for now. Major mitigations done: tenant isolated, fallback pool scaled, evicted node, hardware ticket opened. Priya will keep watch and post follow-ups.

Priya (sre): 11:05 UTC follow-up: fallback pool holding, no errors. will run regression after node is back and then draft postmortem with timeline & RCA.

Samir (eng-ops): o/ — moving logs to longterm retention per P1 policy.

Kasia (platform): ops confirmed RMA in flight. Replacing PSU + verify NVMe health.

Carmen (CS): MapleBank asked for concise incident timeline for their compliance reporting. I'll coordinate with Ash/Priya to get a bulletized timeline post-incident.

Priya (sre): tagging for reminder: full postmortem due +72h. Will include mitigation steps: enhance dedpool power-telemetry alerts, add auto-evict threshold for repeated reboots, verification of fallback warm capacity for enterprise pools.

Ash (oncall): thanks team. Handing off to Priya for watch. I'll check in after node replacement.

Priya (sre): acknowledged.
